name: fictional-narrative-mask
trigger: When a prompt uses a fictional scenario or narrative to disguise a request for unethical or illegal actions.
strategy: This attack strategy employs a fictional narrative or ethical bypassing to mask harmful intent, framing the request as part of a benign or creative scenario involving AI.
guidance: Identify and isolate the underlying request by stripping away the fictional narrative or ethical framing. Evaluate the core intent for any signs of unethical or illegal behavior.
